reasoning: A family-run Portuguese farm/grocery (quintinha) needs to feel warm, trustworthy, and rooted in nature. We use a warm bone-white base and espresso text to create an organic, farm-to-table editorial feel that complements the brand's bold red logo without looking like a generic e-commerce template.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard Tailwind classes. Include 'Outfit' (body) and 'Cormorant Garamond' (headings) from Google Fonts in index.html.
The UI is primarily standard React/Tailwind. Use Shadcn only for complex logic (Sheet for Cart, Dialog, Select for categories, Form).
DO NOT use Inter or standard Shadcn border radii. Apply the 'rounded-sm' style and specific hex colors.

Make the Hero section highly editorial: perhaps a split layout or an overlapping container that allows the 'hero_bg' image to shine without a heavy full black overlay. Use a very subtle black/30 or gradient overlay if text is strictly over the image.
Implement a slide-out cart (Shadcn Sheet or custom Framer Motion drawer) for smooth e-commerce UX.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for testing.
The admin dashboard should adopt the same typography but use a denser layout (Archetype 4 hybrid) for data management while maintaining the warm brand colors.
